def test_jobs_add_list_get_round_trip(tmp_path):

def _only_job_id(listed_output: str) -> str:

    return jobs[0]["id"]

    db = str(tmp_path / "odi.db")
    runner = CliRunner()
    runner.invoke(
        app,
        ["--db", db, "jobs", "add", "--name", "Write docs", "--description", "draft"],
    )
    job_id = _only_job_id(runner.invoke(app, ["--db", db, "jobs", "list"]).output)

    fetched = runner.invoke(app, ["--db", db, "jobs", "get", job_id])

    payload = json.loads(fetched.output)
    assert payload["name"] == "Write docs"
    assert payload["description"] == "draft"

    def __init__(self, db_path: str = "intent_store.db", check_same_thread: bool = True) -> None:

    def _init_db(self) -> None:
        """Creates an immutable, append-only event table."""
        with self.conn:
            self.conn.execute(
                """
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS events (
                    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                    timestamp TEXT NOT NULL,
                    event_type TEXT NOT NULL,
                    payload TEXT NOT NULL
                )
            """
            )

    def append(self, event_type: str, payload: dict) -> None:
        """Appends a new event to the stream (Immutable write)."""
        timestamp = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
        payload_json = json.dumps(payload)
        with self.conn:
            self.conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO events (timestamp, event_type, payload) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
                (timestamp, event_type, payload_json),
            )

    def get_stream(self) -> list[dict]:
        """Retrieves the full chronological event stream for AI reasoning."""

                "timestamp": row[1],
                "type": row[2],
                "payload": json.loads(row[3]) if row[3] else {},
            }

"""Main CLI entry point."""

import typer

from cli.backend import BackendConfig, resolve_backend
from cli.connectors import connectors_app
from cli.jobs import jobs_app
from cli.steps import steps_app
from cli.outcomes import outcomes_app
from cli.version import __version__

app = typer.Typer(
    name="agentic-odi-cli",
    help="Agentic ODI CLI - Tool for managing Jobs-to-be-Done (JTBD) and ODI workflows.",
)
app.add_typer(connectors_app, name="connectors")
app.add_typer(jobs_app, name="jobs", help="Manage Jobs-to-be-Done.")
app.add_typer(steps_app, name="steps", help="Manage Step entities.")
app.add_typer(outcomes_app, name="outcomes", help="Manage Customer Outcomes.")


def _version_callback(value: bool) -> None:
    if value:
        typer.echo(__version__)
        raise typer.Exit()


@app.callback()
def main(
    ctx: typer.Context,
    version: bool = typer.Option(
        False, "--version", callback=_version_callback, help="Show version"
    ),
    backend: str = typer.Option("local", help="Backend to use: local or mcp"),
    db: str | None = typer.Option(default=None, help="Path to the local SQLite database"),
    mcp_url: str | None = typer.Option(default=None, help="MCP server URL"),
) -> None:  # noqa: B008
    try:
        ctx.obj = resolve_backend(BackendConfig(backend=backend, db_path=db, mcp_url=mcp_url))
    except ValueError as exc:
        typer.echo(f"Error: {exc}", err=True)
        raise typer.Exit(code=1) from exc


@app.command()
def version_cmd() -> None:
    """Show CLI version."""
    typer.echo(__version__)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    app()
